description: Reviewer B (jade-alt) B5: src/lib/server/http/readiness.ts owns a private pg pool (max 4, 2 s query_timeout, statement_timeout). Plan A3 says readiness runs 'over the app pool'. When the bead that adds the app's Drizzle pool lands, either readiness must use that pool (without imposing its 2 s limit on app queries, e.g. per-query timeout) or the divergence must be accepted; and closeDatabase on sveltekit:shutdown must close the app pool too.
title: Readiness pool vs the app's real DB pool: decide sharing before Phase 2 adds Drizzle pool
